translations.text: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded all her precious possessions for food to restore their lives. Look, Lord, and take notice, for she has become despised.
They said to their mothers, “Where are grain and wine?” as they grew faint like wounded people in the city streets, as they poured out their lives into their mothers’ laps.

Everyone passing along the road clapped their hands at you. They hissed and shook their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that is the crown of glory, the joy of the whole earth?”

Look, Lord, and take notice: who is it that has afflicted him? Will women eat the fruit of their wombs like this? The cook has inflicted suffering. Will they kill little children nursing at the breast? Or will you kill a priest and a prophet in the Lord’s sanctuary?
He has cast my soul away from peace. I have forgotten my good things.
The Lord is good to those who wait for him. He is good to the soul that seeks him.
He will sit alone and be silent, because he has taken it upon himself.
For the Lord will not abandon him forever.
My eye is in pain. I will not be silent or lift my head.
They put me to death in a pit and laid a stone over me.
You have heard their insults, Lord, and all the schemes they devised against me throughout the day.
Slaves have become our masters. There is no one to rescue us from their hands.
